pages:
[
  "Lumi is a little firefly. She is very small.",
  "The other fireflies shine so bright! Lumi’s light is very dim. She thinks, \"My light is too small!\"",
  "Lumi feels sad. She sits on a big brown branch and starts to cry. Her little light flickers even more.",
  "Then, a small, shaky voice says, “Hello?” Lumi looks up. It's a tiny snail!",
  "The snail says, \"I think your light is the best! It’s just enough for me to see my way home. It is not too bright.\"",
  "Lumi’s heart feels warm. She shines her light for the snail. She feels strong and brave.",
  "Lumi thinks, \"I am The Brave Little Firefly!\" She uses her light to show the snail the path through the tall grass. They chat as they walk.",
  "Shining her little light, Lumi helps many friends. Lumi now knows: her small light is perfect for someone."
]
